parts.name: Opener
parts.Basic_description: The opener is the front panel or lid of the trashcan, made of stainless steel, designed for frequent manual contact.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to open and close the trashcan to dispose of waste easily. It may be hinged or pedal-operated depending on the design.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts outward when opened and returns to a closed position when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the trashcan, made of durable plastic, forming the structural housing.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the trash bag and provides stability to the entire trashcan structure.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports the opener and internal components.
